paper_identity.paper_title: Real Estate Investment Choices and Decision Support Systems

research_target.business_meaning: Areal utility/perceived attractiveness measures how strongly a territory can attract real estate investment choices.

variable_mapping.paper_definition: Access time from house to main services and urban infrastructure.
variable_mapping.transform_needed: Invert travel-time friction into a 0-100 connectivity score; higher means easier access.

variable_mapping.paper_definition: Presence of green areas and perceived environmental quality on high/medium/low ordinal levels.
variable_mapping.transform_needed: Represent as environmental/infrastructure quality on a 0-100 normalized score.

variable_mapping.paper_definition: Safety and quality-of-life context on high/medium/low ordinal levels.
variable_mapping.transform_needed: Use as the project's execution/social context confidence proxy until a dedicated safety feature is added.

variable_mapping.paper_definition: Scenarios compare trade-offs among context attributes under constrained alternatives.
Sense of belonging to a place, associated with place identity.
variable_mapping.transform_needed: Project extension: demand/search interest proxy for revealed market attention.

model_details.model_family: AHP-weighted decision support system with multinomial logit calibration
model_details.algorithm: Analytic Hierarchy Process, stated preference fractional factorial design, multinomial logit
model_details.normalization: Project inputs normalized to 0-100; paper qualitative high/medium/low levels mapped to ordinal score bands.

config_updates.risk_formula: logistic scaled from paper multinomial-logit beta signs plus project supply-risk extension

notes: AHP aggregate weights from Table 4 are mapped to the project's operational indicators. Table 6 beta values are scaled for 0-100 inputs to avoid over-saturating the project risk probability.
